verdicts.reason: A and B are almost pixel-identical and have the same breakage. The rules that should frame LAVANDER are shifted right, so they start at the centre and run off past the text. The rules beside HOMEMADE LOTION have come apart: the left one floats over the lavender sprig and the right one hangs near the vase. The type is also far too small for the wide canvas: SKINCARE is barely legible and the headline is weak inside a large empty frame. The illustration row is just stretched across the bottom rather than rearranged.
